nodes.label: QID/Customer Document Verification
nodes.desc: Same process as activation except the mobile number and sim.
controls: Agent must verified the Customer Authenticity

nodes.label: Agent Checks Eligibility
nodes.desc: Agent checks the outstanding bill if any.
controls: If Bill outstanding then need to clear all dues

nodes.label: Clear Outstanding Dues
nodes.desc: If the bill is outstanding, all dues must be cleared before the park number process can continue.
controls: If Bill outstanding then need to clear all dues

nodes.label: Agent Checks if in Collection
nodes.desc: Agent checks if the number is in collection.
controls: Park number not allowed if already entered in collection

nodes.label: Park Number Rejected
nodes.desc: Park number is not allowed because the number is already entered in collection.
controls: Park number not allowed if already entered in collection

nodes.label: Agent Checks Commitment Plan Status
nodes.desc: Validation check for the commitment plan.
controls: If the customer is in commitment plan then the commitment plan duration will increase by the parked period

nodes.label: Extend Commitment Plan Duration
nodes.desc: The commitment plan duration is increased by the parked period.
controls: If the customer is in commitment plan then the commitment plan duration will increase by the parked period

nodes.desc: Park my number plan is assigned.

nodes.desc: Park my number plan is assigned.
